business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) and Digital Scanning

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China-Vanuatu Bilateral Investment Treaty (2004, in force)
PACER Plus (trade and economic partnership agreement)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2015, as amended; International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 2, 15-18; Companies (Beneficial Ownership and Control) Regulations 2018; VFSC AML/CFT Rules 2016 and subsequent supervisory directives

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each proposed director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the jurisdiction of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Certificate of Good Standing of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate Registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified bank reference letter confirming no adverse AML findings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank of the shareholder or beneficial owner

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of board resolution authorizing incorporation, appointment of registered agent, and nominee arrangements
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or board of directors of the ultimate parent entity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening for all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu AML/CFT Act schedule of designated persons. Full PEP background check is required at onboarding within 30 days of pre-incorporation and re-screening on a continuous risk-based frequency of no less than annually.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Office Online Registry; name search and reservation must be submitted through a licensed registered agent via the VFSC e-registry portal at www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official filings are accepted in English and French. Company names must use the Latin alphabet; names derived from non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into English or French. The name must end with the suffix 'International Company' or 'IC'. Chinese characters or non-Latin scripts are not permitted in the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name reservation is rejected, VFSC will issue an official rejection notice. An amended name may be resubmitted immediately through the same licensed registered agent. A formal administrative appeal must be lodged with the VFSC Legal and Licensing Division within 14 days of the rejection date, accompanied by written submissions and evidence of consent for any sensitive token. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may file for judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 21 days of the appeal decision. An approved name may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the applicable extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted as the company's licensed business activity (providing virtual office and mail scanning services to third-party clients), but the entity itself must maintain a physical statutory registered office in Vanuatu at the office of a licensed registered agent. A remote or virtual address cannot be used as the company's statutory registered office for regulatory correspondence and service of process.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high; approximately 35-45% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 12 months of operation, because the activity is an AML/CFT-sensitive commercial mail receiving agency and the company is classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced under VFSC supervision.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu, Sections 4-12 (incorporation procedure), Section 13 (registered office), Section 15 (registered agent), and Section 122 (tax exemption); Companies Act [Cap. 191] applied as interpretive gap-filler; VFSC Registration and Licensing Rules 2020; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2013.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 — Application for Incorporation of an International Company with annexed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; authorized capital may be denominated in any currency; no escrow account or bank-deposit capital rule applies before registration; VFSC fee tariff is based on authorized capital band.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. RESOLVED by written resolution of the sole director and initial shareholder of the Company: (1) The share subscription recorded in the Subscription Agreement dated [●] is ratified and the subscribed shares are allotted fully paid. (2) The registered office at the premises of [Registered Agent], Port Vila, Vanuatu, is adopted, and [Registered Agent] is confirmed as licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. (3) [Name A] and [Name B] are appointed director and secretary respectively, each consenting to act until the first annual general meeting. (4) The officers and the registered agent are jointly and severally authorized to pay statutory fees, open bank accounts, and execute all filings required for incorporation and licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry — e-Registry portal, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two ranked proposed names on the prescribed Name Reservation Form via the VFSC e-Registry; pay the non-refundable name search fee of VT 5,000 (approximately USD 42); VFSC screens for prohibited, identical, or misleading names before issuing a Name Reservation Approval valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Form (VFSC Form NR-1)
Two proposed company names with Latin-letter transliteration certificate where applicable
Applicant due-diligence cover letter from the licensed registered agent identifying the ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected, submit two further alternative names within 10 business days without an additional search fee; file a VFSC appeal letter disputing the stated ground of refusal if the rejection is contested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed VFSC Registered Agent and a Vanuatu Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association using the standard ICA Schedule, with an objects clause covering virtual office services, commercial mail receiving, digital mail scanning, data processing, and ancillary offshore administrative services; have the incorporator, shareholders, and proposed directors execute the documents before a notary; countersign the registered agent consent.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to Act of Director (Form IC-6)
Consent to Act of Registered Agent (Form IC-R)
Certified passport copies and residential proof of all ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any notarial certificate defects and, for documents executed outside Vanuatu, obtain apostille or consular legalization; re-execute before a Vanuatu notary within 7 days if the registry challenges signature attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Form IC-1 and Settlement of Filing Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry counters or approved online e-Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the constitutional documents and the registered office and registered agent consents; pay the incorporation fee of VT 35,000 (approximately USD 300) and applicable stamp duty; obtain a stamped payment receipt and registry filing number; a paid 24-hour expedited processing service is available.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 — Application for Incorporation of an International Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association (notarized)
Consents to Act of directors and registered agent
VFSC fee payment confirmation receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to a VFSC requisition letter within 14 calendar days by amending and refiling the deficient documents; cure unpaid fees by wire transfer within 3 banking days; no penalty is imposed if the requisition is satisfied within the original service-level window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Certificate Section, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory completion of filings, VFSC registers the International Company in the Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, registered office certificate, and the corporate kit comprising the company seal, statutory registers, and blank share certificates.
required_dossiers: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation
Company statutory registers and minute book
Corporate seal and share certificate specimen
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a replacement or certified copy through the registry requisition form; file a registry rectification notice to correct any typographical error in the company name or date of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed VFSC Registered Agent and VFSC Compliance Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first board resolution; allot and issue share certificates; appoint officers; file notices of registered office and registered agent; file beneficial ownership particulars with the VFSC beneficial ownership register; apply for the Certificate of Tax Exemption under Section 122 of the International Companies Act confirming zero taxation during the 20-year rolling exemption; document the first board meeting minutes.
required_dossiers: First board resolution adopted and signed
Share certificates and allotment register
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent (Form IC-14)
Tax exemption certificate application under Section 122
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Pay the statutory late-notice fee where filing deadlines were missed; amend and re-file the beneficial ownership register to satisfy VFSC anti-money-laundering scrutiny; obtain a corrected tax exemption certificate if the application was mis-described.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence, Bank Account, and Payment Rails Integration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Authority (VIA) Business Licence Office and licensed commercial banks in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for an International Company Business Licence under the Business Licences Act [Cap. 247] if physical service infrastructure will be maintained in Vanuatu; obtain a municipal zoning and occupation permit from the Port Vila City Council; open a corporate bank account with online banking; integrate Stripe Recurring and credit-card acquiring under a merchant acceptance agreement; implement an AML on-boarding program aligned with the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and tax exemption certificate
Business Licence application under Business Licences Act [Cap. 247]
Bank account opening forms and board resolution approving signatories
AML/CFT manual, risk assessment, and data-retention policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Appeal a VIA refusal or conditional grant to the Minister of Finance within 21 days; cure AML policy deficiencies with an external compliance consultant; switch acquiring bank or arrange a payment-facilitator fallback if merchant underwriting is delayed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Authority (VIA) Business Licence Office acting in coordination with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Vanuatu Post Limited, and the Port Vila City Council for Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) authorization
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Business Licence under the Business Licences Act [Cap. 247] and Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) Service Authorization issued by Vanuatu Post Limited for mail receiving and digital scanning operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 — Low-impact administrative and digital-scanning operation; EIA Registration only, no Full EIA Report required; exemption available for premises below 100 m² without standby diesel generators or chemical processing equipment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero point-source industrial wastewater discharge; volatile organic compound emissions from printing and copying equipment not to exceed 0.5 kg per day; server-room heat rejection must not breach municipal noise and thermal limits; compliance with Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations for paper, e-waste, and used batteries through DEPC-approved recyclers; greywater discharge to the Port Vila municipal sewer per water utility by-laws

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate under the Vanuatu Fire Service Act with NFPA 101 life-safety code compliance; structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department for the leased office floor; occupational health and safety clearance under the Employment Act [Cap. 160] workplace-safety provisions; municipal occupancy permit from the Port Vila City Council; fire-extinguisher maintenance and evacuation-drill compliance certificates

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (CIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, through its Value Added Tax Division; corporate registration is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Official online portal: https://www.gov.vu and VAT online services via the CIR portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) from the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department. The application requires: (1) submission of Form TIN-01 (Application for Tax Identification Number) to the CIR, (2) certificate of incorporation issued by VFSC, (3) certified copy of the IC's constitution, (4) registered office address in Vanuatu, (5) identity documents of directors/shareholders (passport, proof of address), and (6) if the IC intends to undertake a taxable activity or hold a business licence, the proposed business licence application or approval. Processing takes approximately 5-10 business days. Although the International Company is tax-exempt from domestic income tax, a TIN may be issued for administrative, customs, business licence, and VAT compliance purposes. If the IC is wholly non-resident and has no Vanuatu-source taxable activity, the IC may not be automatically required to obtain a TIN; however, for virtual office/mail scanning services supplied to international clients, a TIN and VAT registration are recommended to sustain zero-rated export treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no US-style check-the-box election and no OECD hybrid mismatch election mechanism. Under the International Companies Act, an IC may elect in its constitution to maintain confidentiality of shareholders and directors. An IC may also elect to convert to a domestic 'local company' by filing a change-of-status election with the VFSC and CIR, thereby subjecting itself to Vanuatu's domestic tax and VAT rules; such an election is voluntary and must be approved by the VFSC Registrar. Hybrid entity classification is not recognized for domestic tax purposes; there is no deemed disposition or 'dual resident' election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 242], administered by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (five million vatu) annual taxable turnover for a taxable activity; presumptive registration is required for importers of taxable goods or services irrespective of turnover, and a person may voluntarily register for VAT with CIR approval. International Companies providing offshore services solely to non-residents are generally treated as outside the Vanuatu VAT net, but if any local turnover such as mail scanning services to domestic addressees arises, the IC must monitor the VUV 5,000,000 threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or mandatory electronic invoicing regime is currently in force in Vanuatu. VAT-registered suppliers must issue a tax invoice containing the prescribed particulars (supplier name and TIN, recipient name, date, description, VAT amount, VAT-exclusive value, and VAT rate). Invoices may be issued in paper or electronic format, but there is no government API integration, digital stamping, or real-time clearance requirement. VAT returns can be submitted online via the CIR e-filing system; however, the tax authority has not implemented continuous transaction controls or clearance mandates.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (i) exported goods that leave Vanuatu under customs control within the period prescribed in the Value Added Tax Regulations, and (ii) exported services provided to a non-resident customer for consumption wholly outside Vanuatu, including virtual office administrative services, mail receiving and scanning, and other back-office services rendered by an International Company. To qualify, the supplier must be a registered VAT person, the supply must meet the definition of an export under VAT law, and the supplier must retain documentation evidencing the destination, exportation, and receipt by the non-resident. Services that are physically performed in Vanuatu but whose economic use occurs offshore (such as digitized mail scanning sent to a foreign virtual mailbox subscriber) are capable of zero-rating if the sole recipient is a non-resident and no Vanuatu resident benefits from the service. Advance rulings from the CIR are recommended for novel digital-scope service arrangements.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form E1, electronic or paper SAD) endorsed by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice and VAT tax invoice issued by the registered supplier
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank documentary evidence of foreign exchange receipt from the non-resident purchaser
Packing list / shipping manifest for goods exports; for service exports, a dated service contract and delivery receipt confirming offshore receipt and use
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: CIR and Vanuatu Customs apply strict documentary audit scrutiny to export zero-rating claims. If the required customs documentation, shipping evidence, or inward remittance proof is not available within 180 days of supply, the supply is recharacterised as taxable at 12.5%, and the registered person must self-assess and remit the VAT. Fraudulent zero-rating is treated as tax evasion under Section 52 of the VAT Act, attracting a fine of up to VUV 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to five years. Civil penalties may include a late payment penalty of 2% per month of the unremitted VAT, a default assessment based on 150% of the suppressed tax, interest at the statutory rate, and the automatic clawback of any previously refunded VAT. Subsequent third-party facilitators (including promoters of sham export structures) may be jointly and severally liable, and repeat offenders face suspension or cancellation of VAT registration and the business licence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125]; external exchange control matters are additionally referenced to the Exchange Control Act [Cap 121] and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act (FTRA).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current-account payments and profit remittances. No exchange-control approvals, gross reserve retention requirements, or repatriation licences apply to a Vanuatu International Company. The practical barrier is banking counterparty due diligence, not convertibility. Dividend and fee distributions can be made to non-resident shareholders and contractors provided the underlying source-of-funds and business documentation is available to the clearing bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender rule, mandatory conversion ratio, or repatriation timeline applies to export receipts earned by a Vanuatu International Company. Free disposal of proceeds in VUV, USD, AUD, or any permitted settlement currency is allowed without RBV approval, subject only to internal bank anti-money-laundering verification and accurate recordkeeping under the FTRA.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency Operational Account and segregated Capital Escrow Account denominated in USD, AUD, and VUV
Operational Account with Euro and Pacific currency clearing capabilities; escrow-compatible deposit structures
Operational VUV and USD Account, with access to lower-cost cross-border settlement via BSP’s correspondent network
Domestic Operational Account primarily for VUV-denominated statutory payments and local vendor disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium. Vanuatu does not operate a domestic electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing framework, and the RBV does not authorise non-resident digital EMIs to provide local account opening, clearing, or payment acceptance services. Overseas EMIs can be used receptively for low-value recurring client inflows via Stripe/card rails, but tier-1 Vanuatu banks will not treat such EMIs as compliant settlement counterparties for export proceeds, tax remittance, or capital injections. Any such inbound collection must be swept to a licensed commercial bank through a referenced SWIFT/card-payout protocol.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is not statutorily mandated under the International Companies Act, but prudent tier-1 banks require a live banker interview. In practice, at least the authorised signatory or a director must attend one in-branch or notarised video verification session in Port Vila, accompanied by an introduction letter from the licensed registered agent. Remote-only onboarding is possible only where the beneficial owner already maintains an existing relationship with the bank or where acceptable introduced-business procedures apply.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner or signatory appears in global sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media screening alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original passport and proof of address, formal PEP status declaration, professional reference from a regulated CPA or attorney, corporate register extract, and a written explanation of the exact role in the virtual-office and mail-scanning business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity on a mail-scanning account without matching commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed client contracts for mail-scanning and forwarding, invoice schedules, digital log output from the scanning platform, physical office lease or sub-lease proof, and completed source-of-funds declarations from remitters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of a virtual office address as the primary operating address and registered address triggers negative classification as a shell-company entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Licensed registered agent certificate, dated physical office access agreement, utility or service bill issued to the entity, and a certified statement of on-site staff/service capacity dedicated to mail handling and digital storage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming wire transfers or card deposits from third parties not listed as contractual clients of the CMRA service.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customer ledger mapping, remitter bank confirmation, underlying invoicing for administered mail volume, and anti-money-laundering clearance note from the originating financial counterparty.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound protocol: The investor or shareholder initiates an SWIFT MT103 from a bank account that has completed its own KYC; the payment must clearly reference 'PAID-IN CAPITAL – INVOICE/SUBSCRIBER REF [unique ID]' and include the relevant capital subscription register. No exchange-control permit is required, but the receiving Vanuatu bank will verify source-of-funds documentation and align the purpose code with the International Company’s subscribed share capital or non-current shareholder loan. Funds are cleared directly to the segregated Capital Escrow Account whenever the transaction exceeds USD 10,000; smaller operating collections may route to the Operational Account after standard negative-news and counterparty-name screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are conducted primarily via SWIFT MT103 for software licensing, scanning subcontracts, and administrative services paid to overseas vendors. For physical equipment purchases and machinery importation, a documentary Irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) is the preferred clearing rail, with the Vanuatu bank issuing against a confirmed client purchase order and shipping invoice. Interbank treasury repositioning uses MT202 COV, and local VUV-denominated payments for customs, utility, and government fees are cleared directly through RBV settlement and domestic bank transfer rails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore deliverable foreign-exchange forwards in USD, AUD, and EUR executed with international counterparties under an ISDA/CSA framework
Vanuatu vatu versus Australian dollar or US dollar FX swaps arranged through an RBV-licensed commercial bank with matched maturity to trade receipts
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV provided by licensed offshore banks, documented onshore as residual-risk hedging and settled in USD

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (prescribed form under Section 70, International Companies Act [Cap. 222])
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after every anniversary of incorporation; the anniversary date is set by the certificate of incorporation and reflected in the VFSC corporate register.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to VUV 10,000 (approximately USD 84) plus an accruing monthly default penalty until the return is filed; failure to file annual returns for two consecutive anniversaries permits VFSC to institute administrative strike-off and dissolution, after which company assets vest in the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and UBO Register Return (under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register, submitted through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, contemporaneously with the Annual Return; additionally, within 30 calendar days after any share transfer or change in the beneficial ownership holding of 25 percent or more of shares or voting rights.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty of VUV 25,000 (approximately USD 211) for late or omitted UBO confirmation; knowingly false or misleading UBO declarations attract criminal liability, and repeated default constitutes a ground for VFSC strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from mandatory independent audit of financial statements. Compulsory audit is triggered only when the company holds a VFSC regulatory licence (banking, insurance, securities or fiduciary services) or when an audit is required under the company's licence conditions or by member resolution. A virtual office and commercial mail receiving agency operating as a tax-exempt International Company has no statutory audit obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory GAAP is imposed on offshore International Companies; accounting records should be prepared on a recognized framework such as IFRS (or an equivalently recognized standard acceptable to the registered agent), because financial statements are not publicly filed and remain private.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every share transfer must be evidenced by a written instrument, recorded in the Register of Members on the same business day, and notified to the licensed registered agent without delay. An annual confirmation statement identifying each beneficial owner of 25 percent or more of shares or voting rights must be signed by a director or the registered agent and filed with VFSC at each anniversary date; any share transfer resulting in a change to that beneficial ownership position must be reported to VFSC within 30 days of completion.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 to USD 650 per annum for licensed registered agent services plus physical registered office in Port Vila
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 because statutory audit is exempt; a voluntary certified audit or review for a virtual-office and mail-scanning International Company would range from USD 1,500 to USD 3,500.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding taxes on International Companies. The International Companies Act and the VAT Act confer tax-exempt status on qualifying ICs engaged in offshore activities, provided they do not derive income from local domestic sources and do not carry on business with residents in Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax return form for International Companies. Filing is limited to annual license renewal via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online portal and, where applicable, annual VAT return if the entity voluntarily registers for VAT on local services.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual license renewal and exemption certificate confirmation due by the anniversary date of incorporation or the VFSC-designated renewal date; no income tax filing deadline applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: VFSC Annual Return / License Renewal Application
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent confirmation, registered office address, director and shareholder particulars, statement of no local domestic business activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must confirm maintained status as non-residents and that no business has been conducted with Vanuatu residents, to preserve the tax-exempt IC classification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal penalties imposed by VFSC: a default penalty of up to VUV 50,000 for failure to file annual return; continued default may lead to strike-off and dissolution. No daily surcharge for income tax exists given the zero-tax regime.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not entered into comprehensive double tax agreements. Tax exemption on dividends is automatic at source for ICs; no treaty relief procedure or Tax Residence Certificate application is required. Legal counsel opinion and VFSC exemption confirmation are standard practice for banking counterparties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest is 0% for International Companies. With no income tax statute in force, interest and IP royalty payments are not subject to WHT and no DTA treaty rate applies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No local currency threshold; Vanuatu International Companies are not subject to transfer pricing documentation obligations because there is no corporate income tax. Contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation is nevertheless market practice for ultimate parent jurisdictions with CFC or income inclusion rules.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently apply EU-style Economic Substance Regulations. However, ICs must maintain a registered agent in Vanuatu and should avoid creating a local physical presence that could be deemed domestic trading income, which would trigger the income tax exemption loss and VAT registration risk.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting domestic trading activity or deriving income from Vanuatu sources without disclosure to VFSC while claiming pure offshore status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of exemption, retroactive income tax assessment, monetary penalties, and deregistration under the International Companies Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for unpaid taxes if they authorize undisclosed local trading; criminal fines and disqualification from management can apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a virtual office and mail scanning business with no disclosed beneficiary information, no registered agent compliance, or use of nominee directors to conceal ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off, revocation of license, and fines under the International Companies Act and Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal fine and imprisonment for AML failures; travel bans may be imposed pending investigation of illicit funds flows.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the mail scanning and virtual office platform to receive, forward, or launder proceeds of fraud or to obscure the originator of payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to VUV 10 million and license suspension for registered agents; confiscation of funds and corporate assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability with imprisonment up to 15 years; directors as beneficial owners risk travel bans and civil restitution orders.
